run_flickr_downloader: run the flickr_downloader script to download photos from Flickr using a search query and API key
run_parse_page: run parse_page to fetch and parse a page of Flickr photo search results from the API
run_compose_url: run compose_url to build a Flickr API search URL with pagination and date range parameters
run_photo_downloader: run the PhotoDownloader class to download individual photos from Flickr by their URL attributes
run_parse_args: run parse_args to parse command line arguments for search text, API key, image path, and process count
